verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe Types with custom Properties as blueprints for Objects, and Queries that let users define criteria which the system 'assembles... as a View' — with GitHub docs confirming database views including tables, kanban boards, and calendars. Community confirms tables exist as a real feature, though notes formulas aren't yet supported, indicating some limits to query sophistication. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of complex multi-property filtering/sorting, list-view specifics, and confirmation that all view types (not just table/kanban) are fully live and query-driven rather than static.
